Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

meweasmo 0.3.1

  • Documentation of the multilayer model rewritten: how beta becomes the matrix M of metaWebNetAssemblyMLCT(), the two sources of link signs (layer table or per-link attribute), and the convention of default_layer_signs().
  • New article vignette("multilayer-assembly") with the Chilean rocky intertidal multiplex network of Kéfi et al. (2015) from the multiweb package.
  • pkgdown site (https://lsaravia.github.io/meweasmo/) built by GitHub Actions.
  • README: section on multilayer networks.
  • Removed the placeholder MetaWebAssemblyModels-package help page.

meweasmo 0.3.0

New features

  • metaWebNetAssemblyML(): multilayer version of the continuous-time metaweb assembly model. Non-trophic layers change the extinction rates: a species present with a positive effect (mutualism, commensalism) lowers the extinction rate of its partner and one with a negative effect (competition, amensalism) raises it, e_i(t) = e_i exp(beta_neg f-_i - beta_pos f+_i), with f the fraction of partners present (normalize = FALSE adds the effects per partner instead). Optional obligate dependence (obligate_on, obligate_layers): dependent species go extinct with rate se when none of the species they depend on (e.g. foundation species) is present. Takes an mgraph or list of igraph layers, an igraph with a layer attribute, or an edge data.frame; uses a per-link sign attribute (effect_attr) when present, otherwise the layer signs of default_layer_signs(). With beta = 0 and no obligate rule it is metaWebNetAssemblyCT().
  • build_multilayer_assembly(): the matrices of the multilayer model, to check how the layers were translated.
  • metaWebNetAssemblyMLCT(): the C++ core of the multilayer model (extinction rates simulated exactly by thinning).

meweasmo 0.2.0

New features

  • metaWebNetAssemblyCT(): continuous-time version of the metaweb assembly model, simulated with the Gillespie algorithm (migration, local extinction and secondary extinction events with per-species rates).
  • generateGLVparmsFromAdjR(): pure R implementation of generateGLVparmsFromAdj().
  • generateGLVparmsFromAdj() supports gamma-distributed interaction strengths (rndType = 1, with predIntSd) in addition to uniform ones.
  • metaWebNetAssemblyGLV(): ini can now be a single value, recycled to all species (e.g. 0 for an empty initial community).
  • Added a testthat test suite covering all exported functions.

Bug fixes

  • generateGLVparmsFromAdjR(): with rndType = 1 the gamma scale was passed as rate to rgamma(), giving interaction strengths about 8 orders of magnitude too large. It now matches generateGLVparmsFromAdj().
  • neutralNetAssembly(): double interactions (A -> B and B -> A) were documented as forbidden but could be created; they are now prevented.
  • metaWebNetAssemblyGLV(): a scalar ini (documented as allowed) shrank the population vector and read memory out of bounds. Arguments ini, m and r are now validated and give an error if their length does not match nrow(metaW).
  • generateGLVparmsFromAdj(): no longer modifies the input matrix in place when it has double storage.

Documentation

  • metaWebNetAssembly() and metaWebNetAssemblyCT(): documented the differences between the discrete and continuous time versions (probabilities vs. rates, synchronous vs. one event at a time, cascading secondary extinctions), cross-referenced them, and cite Saravia et al. (2022) as the main reference.
  • metaWebNetAssemblyGLV(): rewrote the documentation. It now gives the model equation, explains the tau-leap integration, the meaning of the interaction matrix signs, that m is an immigration rate in individuals per unit of time (not a probability) and that tau is the step size (not a number of steps), describes each element of the returned list, and adds a reference and examples.
  • generateGLVparmsFromAdj() and generateGLVparmsFromAdjR(): documented how interaction types, species types (mutualistic, basal, consumer), self-limitation, growth and migration rates are generated. Removed the statement that the Rcpp version “presumably has memory issues”: the in-place modification of the input was fixed and both versions give the same results.
  • roxygen2 now uses markdown (Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)).
  • calcPropInteractionsGLVadjMat(): documented that proportions are computed over directed matrix entries, so mutualism and competition (two entries each) weigh twice as much as the other interaction types.
  • tests/testthat.R referred to the old package name; fixed.

meweasmo 0.1.8

  • Initial versions: trophic theory of island biogeography based metaweb assembly (metaWebNetAssembly()), neutral and cascade assembly models, stochastic generalized Lotka-Volterra assembly (metaWebNetAssemblyGLV()) and helpers to generate GLV interaction matrices and parameters.
